response.query: How can we incorporate time-varying travel times (heat peak windows, transit schedules) into accessibility models with available mobility data?
response.answer: Incorporate time-varying travel times by using dynamic routing algorithms and real-time transit data in accessibility models. Adjust for heat peak windows using time-dependent accessibility metrics. Use mobility data to refine schedules and peak hours.

analysing data often in large amounts This hands on workshop teaches researchers the fundamental data skills they need to conduct their work and provides high quality domain specific training covering the full lifecycle of data driven research The domain specific approach allows participants to tailor the data content and tools to reflect the specific data and analysis needs of different areas Audience The course is aimed at graduate students and other researchers in the life sciences who would like to learn good practices in data management and analysis The course is ideally suited to students without prior experience in computational research but some familiarity with working with tabular data on a computer is welcome Modules Data organisation and cleaning Versioning with Git
